_: The alley's roof run (BRIEF_ADDENDUM D9, D10; Shared/Attractions/AlleyRoof), all baked by tools/bake/alley/Alley into build/Attractions.rbxm: the yard house and its tree (Yard), the lane hall's raised roof with its trusses, braces, light rails and lamps (Roof), the rooftop vent, its duct and the drop onto a truss (RoofVent), the people's stair, the guard platform and the fences (RoofStairs). Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D. Groups: 'routes' draws the roof run's routes (yellow the way up, orange the leap's flight with no key, cyan the vent and the rafters); 'squirrels' stands the placeholder squirrel where the motor puts one (the ridge's end, the gutter, the bough, past the trunk's top, on the wing roof, at the bent slat, on chord 9120, on a light rail) and the placeholder people (a guard at the louvre, one on the stair's second flight); 'plan' outlines, review only: the yard annex (yellow), the backstage reserve (red), lounge one (magenta), the stairs and landings (white), the platform's grating (cyan), the people fence (orange), the apron (green), the vent unit's curb (blue). The invisible fences and caps are not drawn (transparent). Render: the bakes, then lune run tools/review/export.luau --out build/review_roof/scene.json; lune run tools/review/alley_roof.luau; render.py --scene build/review_roof/scene.json --views tools/review/views_alley_roof.json --out build/review_roof. Committed pictures: docs/renders/alley_roof/.

views.name: y1_yard_from_the_east
views.desc: The house, the tree and the games wing behind them, from the open ground east of the house at eye height.

views.name: y2_house_street_side
views.desc: The house's north (street) side: the porch and door, the shutters, the downspout by the right-hand corner.

views.name: y3_squirrel_at_the_downspout
views.desc: Squirrel's eye at the foot of the downspout, looking up the pipe it runs into.

views.name: y4_ridge_to_the_bough
views.desc: Squirrel's eye behind the squirrel at the ridge's west end: the house bough across the way, where the leap lands.

views.name: y5_the_leap_with_routes
views.desc: The leap from the north side: the ridge, the flight with no key held (orange), the bough and on along the crossing to the wing roof (one route, 9105).

views.name: y6_on_the_bough_to_the_roof
views.desc: A squirrel on the house bough, running down to the trunk's top, the games wing's roof beyond (seen from over the house's north-west corner).

views.name: y7_from_the_guard_platform
views.desc: A guard's eye on the platform's louvre strip, a step east of the guard at the louvre, looking east: the people's fence, the open roof, the parapet the crossing comes over, the tree, its limb to the house and the house's ridge end-on.

views.name: y8_from_the_wing_roof
views.desc: Squirrel's eye on the wing roof where Q drops it, looking back at the crossing, the tree and the house.

views.name: y9_aerial_routes
views.desc: The whole run from the north-east, 70 up: the house, the tree, the games wing, the routes to the vent and the rafters over the lanes.

views.name: y10_squirrel_on_the_gutter
views.desc: A squirrel halfway up the gutter route, from behind and above: its feet on the slates of the north slope (the body is drawn on the route, not lifted like a bough).

views.name: y11_trunk_top_from_the_bough
views.desc: Squirrel's eye behind a squirrel on the bough, looking down it to the trunk's top, where the same limb turns west as the crossing over the wing's parapet.

views.name: y12_site_plan_from_above
views.desc: Straight down over the site: the raised hall roof, the games wing's roof with the vent, the platform and the stair, the yard (house, tree), the routes, and the review-only outlines.

views.name: y13_guard_view_to_the_ridge_end
views.desc: A guard on the louvre strip looking at the ridge's west end, narrow (fov 42): the ridge, where the leap goes, the bough it lands on.

views.name: r1_lanes_looking_up
views.desc: A bowler's eye on lane 9's approach looking up: the score monitors on their rods, the box trusses across the hall, the light rails and their lamps over the lane pairs, a squirrel creeping along one rail.

views.name: r2_rafters_squirrel_eye
views.desc: Squirrel's eye behind a squirrel on chord 9120 over lane 15, looking west along the truss's plate between its two lattice planes; the light rails below, the deck above.

views.name: r3_the_boot_onto_the_chord
views.desc: Squirrel's eye on the east aisle brace (route 9139) looking north at the vent's drop standing on the D 16.5 truss's plate between its lattice planes, its boot open onto the plate under the grille swung up. The roof space is dim here, as it is meant to be.

views.name: r4_on_a_light_rail
views.desc: Squirrel's eye on the light rail over lanes 9-10, looking down the lanes: the rail with its cans and washes under it, a squirrel ahead on it, the plates crossing overhead, the masking header at the end.

views.name: r5_louvre_squirrel_eye
views.desc: Squirrel's eye on the wing roof, from the south-east past the guard, at the unit's louvre bank: the gap where the lowest slats are gone, the bent slat over it, a squirrel at the mouth.

views.name: r6_unit_from_the_walkway
views.desc: A guard's eye from the walkway's south-east corner: the air-handling unit (louvres, doors, plate, stack and fan), the duct to the hall's raised wall, the gratings and the fence rails.

views.name: r7_guard_at_the_louvre
views.desc: From the north strip: the guard standing on the louvre strip at the bent slat (his kick reaches it, not the duct), the apron, the fence on the east line, the open roof beyond.

views.name: r8_stairs_from_the_yard
views.desc: From the yard south-east of the games wing at eye height: the three-flight steel stair up the wing's back wall, its landings on columns, the guard rails, a person on the second flight, the platform's rails at the top.

views.name: r9_climbing_the_stairs
views.desc: A person's eye on the second landing looking up the top flight to the cut in the parapet.

views.name: r10_top_landing_into_the_cut
views.desc: From the top landing looking north through the parapet's cut onto the walkway: the unit, the duct and the guard beyond.

views.name: r11_vent_from_above
views.desc: From above the wing roof to the north-east: the unit and its stack, the duct into the hall's raised east wall, the platform round it with the fences, the stair's top, the crossing coming over the parapet.

views.name: r12_site_from_the_south_east
views.desc: The whole site from high in the south-east: the raised hall roof over the lanes, the games wing with the vent and the platform, the stair, the yard house and its tree.
